definitions.gloss: varied; full of variety; rich in change; diverse
definitions.explanation: Describes something that has abundant variation or diversity. Used for landscapes, climates, experiences, content, and other things characterized by richness and variety.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{変化|へんか}に{富|と}んだ⟦{地形|ちけい}→地形：12083_chikei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧。
{変化|へんか}に{富|と}んだ⟦メニュー→メニュー：11166_menyuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{秘密|ひみつ}→秘密：02504_himitsu⟧だ。
examples.english: The varied menu is the secret to its popularity.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{四季|しき}→四季：11809_shiki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{通|つう}じて→通じる：02289_tsuujiru⟧{変化|へんか}に{富|と}んだ⟦{景色|けしき}→景色：01395_keshiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{楽|たの}しめる→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧。
examples.english: This area offers diverse scenery to enjoy throughout the four seasons.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
The pattern ～⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{富|と}む→富む：12343_tomu⟧ means "to be rich in ~" and is productive: ⟦{栄養|えいよう}→栄養：01882_eiyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{富|と}む→富む：12343_tomu⟧ (rich in nutrition), ⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{富|と}む→富む：12343_tomu⟧ (rich in experience). Most commonly appears in the attributive form ～⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{富|と}んだ→富む：12343_tomu⟧ modifying a noun.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {変化|へんか}に{富|と}んだ⟦{景色|けしき}→景色：01395_keshiki⟧ (varied scenery)
- {変化|へんか}に{富|と}んだ⟦{内容|ないよう}→内容：01482_naiyou⟧ (varied content)
- {変化|へんか}に{富|と}んだ⟦{人生|じんせい}→人生：03355_jinsei⟧ (a life full of changes)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦バラエティ→バラエティ：11398_baraeti⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{富|と}む→富む：12343_tomu⟧: rich in variety — uses the loanword ⟦バラエティ→バラエティ：11398_baraeti⟧
- ⟦{多彩|たさい}→多彩：12165_tasai⟧な: colorful, diverse — a single-word adjective alternative
- ⟦{多様|たよう}→多様：12180_tayou⟧な: diverse — more formal/academic
